topic: Children's voices reading lessons come from an empty school classroom on a holiday.

episode.title: Midnight Watch: The Holiday Lesson

shots.narration: The school was closed, but the children kept reading.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, 3D animated Pakistani haveli courtyard at night, brass lantern between Bashir and Saad, no writing anywhere.
shots.action: Bashir points toward the distant school roof.
shots.mood: Cold moonlight, warm lantern glow, deep archway shadows.

shots.narration: Bashir told Saad what happened during his holiday patrol.
shots.scene: The same haveli courtyard, Bashir in his brown shawl and white cap opposite Saad in his green hoodie.
shots.action: Bashir lifts his old brass lantern.
shots.mood: Quiet storytelling, drifting ground fog, uneasy amber light.

shots.narration: [whispers] Every classroom was locked, except the one upstairs.
shots.scene: Story flashback, deserted Pakistani village school staircase, one open classroom doorway above, bare walls without signs.
shots.action: Bashir climbs the stone stairs with his lantern.
shots.mood: Narrow moonbeams, peeling plaster, heavy darkness upstairs.

shots.narration: Children's voices repeated a lesson behind that open door.
shots.scene: Upper school corridor beside the open classroom, dusty floor and a dark doorway.
shots.mood: Listening tension, amber light stopping at the threshold.

shots.scene: Empty classroom with wooden desks, a teacher's table, and a completely blank blackboard.
shots.action: Bashir extends his lantern into the classroom.
shots.mood: Long desk shadows, suspended dust, cold blue window light.

shots.narration: [surprised] Then one empty chair pulled itself out.
shots.scene: Close view of a wooden classroom desk and its empty chair, lantern glow entering from the doorway.
shots.action: The chair slides backward across the dusty floor.
shots.mood: Fresh scrape through dust, unsettling stillness around the chair.

shots.narration: A second chair moved, then a third.
shots.scene: Three empty desks in the moonlit classroom, the first chair already pulled out.
shots.action: Two more chairs slide backward together.
shots.mood: Orderly movement without occupants, lengthening black shadows.

shots.narration: All the voices stopped when Bashir reached the teacher's table.
shots.scene: Front of the empty classroom, bare teacher's table before a blank blackboard.
shots.action: Bashir sets his lantern on the teacher's table.
shots.mood: Abrupt stillness, lantern-lit beard, darkness crowding the windows.

shots.narration: [whispers] One small voice asked him to take the lesson home.
shots.scene: Teacher's table with the brass lantern, empty chairs beyond it, no writing on any surface.
shots.mood: Intimate dread, trembling amber reflections on glass.

shots.narration: He reached for the lantern, and its flame turned blue.
shots.scene: Close view of Bashir's still hand beside the lantern on the bare teacher's table.
shots.action: The lantern flame changes from amber to blue.
shots.mood: Unnatural blue light, surrounding classroom almost completely black.

shots.narration: Tiny handprints pressed against the glass, from inside.
shots.scene: Extreme close view of the blue-lit brass lantern, Bashir's frightened face behind it.
shots.action: Small hand-shaped condensation marks bloom across the inside glass.
shots.mood: Claustrophobic supernatural terror, brilliant blue flame, sharp reflected eyes.

shots.narration: [whispers] Tomorrow, I'll tell Saad why it started announcing railway stations.
shots.scene: Return to the haveli courtyard, the same lantern between Bashir and Saad, blue light beneath its brass rim.
shots.action: The lantern projects a railway-track-shaped shadow across the courtyard floor.
shots.mood: Impossible shadow, lingering blue glow, fog swallowing the courtyard.

episode.endHook: Tomorrow night, the lesson continues at an abandoned railway station.
episode.description: On a school holiday, Bashir Chacha hears children reading inside an empty classroom. By lantern light, he tells Saad why he should never have opened its door. A fictional spooky story from Midnight Watch.
